Name: Rustic Country Town Interiors
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
[list]
[*]Recolours and redesigns almost all the interior items and building structures used for the town interiors and spouse rooms.
[*]The town interior changes throughout 4 seasons, with different festive and foliage decors.
[*]Including interior recolour of all the farm buildings. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5351]Industrial Kitchen and Interior[/url] for farmhouse interiors.
[*]Supports Vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1149]Karmylla's Immersive Maps[/url]﻿. (Images showcase KIM's redesigned maps and SVE's new maps)
[*]Compatible with all existing map recolours.
[/list][b]

[/b][b]Config options: ([u]default option)[/u][/b]

[size=2]  "White Structure": "true/[u]false[/u]", - Switch between the dark beams and the white beams.
  "Coop": "[u]true[/u]/false",
  "Bathhouse": "[u]true[/u]/false",
